title: German-Style Stir Fry with Garlic
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, this stir fry combines the bold flavors of Germany with the quick cooking method of Asia.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sirloin strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the sirloin from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cooked sirloin back into the skillet and stir in the rice noodles.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Slice the onion and bell peppers into thin strips.
